sources.title: Facing up to Arrangements: Face-Count Formulas for Partitions of Space by Hyperplanes
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the established hyperplane-arrangement language for cells/faces induced by finite affine hyperplane cuts. P024 uses that language only after reachable future translations determine which integer guard boundaries are relevant.
sources.not_claimed: Hyperplane arrangements, their induced cells/faces, and classical region/face counting theory are established mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Computing holes in semi-groups and its applications to transportation problems
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established affine-semigroup language for saturation and holes, including explicit infinite hole families. P024 uses it to block an invalid promotion of the one-dimensional finite numerical-semigroup hole picture to arbitrary higher-dimensional action monoids.
sources.not_claimed: Affine semigroups, saturation, holes, infinite hole families, and saturation-point/conductor questions are established prior mathematics.
